command:
cat > /tmp/gdbrun.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: gdbrun.sh <gdb-cmd-file> [timeout]
set -u
CMD="$1"
TMO="${2:-180}"
cd /home/starryreverie/userdata/development/rCore-Tutorial-Code-2026A/os
# clean leftovers by exact process name (does not match this shell)
for p in $(pgrep -x qemu-system-riscv64); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 1
qemu-system-riscv64 -machine virt -nographic \
  -bios ../bootloader/rustsbi-qemu.bin \
  -device loader,file=target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os.bin,addr=0x80200000 \
  -s -S >/tmp/qemu-gdbserver.log 2>&1 &
QEMU_PID=$!
sleep 2
timeout "$TMO" gdb -nx -q -batch -x "$CMD" \
  target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os
RC=$?
kill "$QEMU_PID" 2>/dev/null
wait "$QEMU_PID" 2>/dev/null
exit $RC
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/gdbrun.sh
cat > /tmp/gdbtest.cmd <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language rust
target remote localhost:1234
break os::mm::memory_set::MemorySet::new_kernel
continue
bt 5
info args
info registers satp
quit
EOF
/tmp/gdbrun.sh /tmp/gdbtest.cmd 90 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
